sourceChecks: Full code-specific monitor tables and displayed troubleshooting procedures read before atomic reservation. No inhibit-column-only or index-only assignments.

Honda physical PDF pages verified with /usr/bin/pdfinfo; all cited extracts downloaded, SHA256 recorded, full text retains form-feed page boundaries. Representative table pages rendered and visually inspected.
Nissan detection, confirmation and complete displayed repair branches read by exact HTML heading; linked procedures not displayed are explicitly identified as limits instead of invented.
All prose explicitly authored per code. Serialization scripts format authored JSON only. Shared factory procedures have distinct channel, condition, threshold or outcome interpretation.
High-voltage access, park-pawl, fuel-vapor and other hazardous work stays at qualified professional boundaries. No live high-voltage probing or disassembly recipe is reproduced.
